title: Dashboard State
description: Current project state snapshot for dev project dashboard

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when state was last updated

updated_by.description: Identifier of agent/person who updated state (e.g., 'claude-code', 'Fish')

about.description: Full human-facing product explanation shown near the top of the dashboard

what.description: Plain-language explanation of what this project actually is

how.description: Plain-language explanation of how it works / is structured

why.description: Plain-language explanation of why this project exists / the problem it solves

features.description: List of current features, in plain language

screenshots.description: Real screenshots of the actual product UI, shown on the dashboard

path.description: Path to the image file, relative to the dashboard's public/ directory

label.description: Plain-language caption describing what the screenshot shows

changes_in_progress.description: List of active changes/features being worked on

name.description: Change name/title (technical slug, e.g. Spectra change name)

icon.description: Key into the dashboard template's built-in SVG icon set (e.g. 'gift', 'layers', 'headset'), shown next to display_name. Falls back to a generic wrench icon if the key is unknown.

display_name.description: Human-friendly title shown instead of the raw technical slug

plain_summary.description: One-line plain-language explanation of what this change actually does, for non-technical readers

detail.description: Full plain-language status: real goals, actual blockers, and what's genuinely happening — not vague filler. Supports simple **bold** markers.

link.description: URL to the change's full SR docs (proposal/design/tasks) for readers who want more detail. Rendered as a plain-language labeled link, never shown as raw text.

open_questions.description: List of unresolved questions blocking progress

asked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when question was asked

key_files.description: List of important file paths in the project

connected_systems.description: List of external services this project depends on
